commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Policy doctor fix-class metadata and optional `HealthFinding.fixRecommendation` output while keeping Policy attestation payloads free of that recommendation metadata, plus stacked gateway node-command policy docs/tests.

PR surface: Source +639, Tests +247, Docs +32, Other +8. Total +926 across 15 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. this is a feature/API-shape PR rather than a bug report. The review path is source inspection plus proof assessment for the new doctor finding output.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human maintainer review is required because this PR is draft, protected by the `maintainer` label, stacked on an open prerequisite, changes an additive public doctor/plugin-SDK output contract, and still needs real behavior proof.

target.title: policy: classify doctor fix recommendations
target.body:
## Summary  - add policy doctor fix metadata covering every current policy finding - classify findings as automatic, reviewRequired, manual, validateOnly, or unsupported - attach structured `fixRecommendation` data to emitted policy findings without changing `doctor --fix` - keep attestation payloads stable by leaving recommendation metadata out of `attestedFindings` - add metadata/tests that fail when a policy check id lacks a fix classification  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/health-checks.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/health-checks.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check`  Not run to completion:  - `pnpm tsgo:core` is blocked in this local worktree by pre-existing untracked `src/oc-path/` files with unused-symbol errors (`hasWildcard`, `JsonlLine`).  ## Stack  Stacked on #99121 (`policy: cover gateway node commands`). This PR includes `policy/gateway-node-command-denied` in the fix-class coverage, so it should be reviewed after/against #99121 and rebased onto `main` after #99121 lands.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Policy doctor findings expose structured `fixRecommendation` metadata for current policy check ids while attested findings remain stable and recommendation-free.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `283c1bb4ca` and this PR head `abf8abfe68`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`
3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
4. `pnpm lint:extensions`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix:
The focused policy/core Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests and 297 policy doctor tests, including fix metadata coverage and the assertion that `attestedFindings` omit `fixRecommendation`. The SDK surface tooling test passed 7 tests after the main-merge conflict resolution. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, and `git diff --check` all exited 0.

Observed result after fix:
The policy plugin now has fix-class metadata coverage for every policy finding in this stack, and attestation output remains unchanged.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
